card.name: Space before a number of days or weeks
card.fires_on: Mostly the space right after 'for', 'every' or 'initial' that comes just before a number plus a time unit such as days, weeks or hours. Also a few word-start letters like F in Fuchs' and I in Ipratropium.

modes.label: Space before a duration
modes.description: The blank space after for, every or initial, just before a number of days, weeks, hours or minutes.
modes.example: ANNOVERA should be taken out of the vagina for<< >>7 days.

modes.label: Start of a name
modes.description: The first letter of a capitalised name after a parenthesis or heading, such as Fuchs' or Ipratropium.
